A bill for an act relating to human services; increasing funding for regional and local dementia grants; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; DEMENTIA GRANTS. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; increasing funding for regional and local dementia grants; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; DEMENTIA GRANTS.

$750,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $750,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for regional and local dementia grants administered by the Minnesota Board on Aging under Minnesota Statutes, section 256.975, subdivision 11.
additions: $750,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $750,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for regional and local dementia grants administered by the Minnesota Board on Aging under Minnesota Statutes, section 256.975, subdivision 11.
